title: Agent Onboarding Mode
description: How a party takes on counterparties it has not worked with. The direction comes from where the value appears: in a seller's account.agent_onboarding, how the seller onboards buyer agents for one billing party or for sandbox access; in a buyer's trust.json posture (core/buyer-onboarding-posture.json), how the buyer considers sellers. Absent means undeclared, never invite_only.

enumDescriptions.open: Seller posture: a buyer agent that meets every listed requirement, and whose identity the seller can establish from the agent's published keys (the Web Bot Auth profile, docs/building/by-layer/L1/security.mdx §Web Bot Auth identities), may proceed without prior contact. A seller that only maps opaque, seller-issued credentials MUST NOT declare open. What open allows is in docs/protocol/get_adcp_capabilities.mdx#accountagent_onboarding. Buyer posture: a seller that meets every listed requirement is in the buyer's consideration set without prior contact; the buyer discovers and calls it, and nothing is sent to the buyer.
enumDescriptions.application: The counterparty completes an out-of-band step at url before it is recognized for this mode: the buyer agent, in a seller's posture; the seller, in a buyer's posture.
enumDescriptions.invite_only: The publishing party does not take unsolicited counterparties for this mode. url MAY be absent.
